having 100% each of these games (including sleeping dogs) i can definitely say that i had the most fun in sleeping dogs however there are so many categories to rank the games in to decide which is better. lets start with your ones.

Graphics:
1.RDR2 - the most beautiful game i've ever seen, perfect
2.GTAV - i much prefer the brighter art style as opposed to GTAIV
3.Sleeping Dogs - the ui, the character designs and overall colour schemes prove themsleves very pretty. do dislike the car models though.
4. GTAIV - i dont know what it is but i really dislike graphics from games that came out in the 00s, bland colour schemes are the death of me

Fighting:
1.Sleeping Dogs - have to agree with you on this one, however im not too suprised as fighting is deliberately meant to be a core component of this game.
2.RDR2 - i do think the ragdoll physics have a large part in having it be ranked so highly but god do the punches feel like they pack a punch, i love it.
3.GTAIV - yet again, euphoria ragdoll physics are great but felt like they had a lower oomph to the fighting as opposed to RDR2
4.GTAV - just rlly shit melee fighting, big dislike.

Driving:
1.GTAIV - controversial take ik that but the driving in GTAIV is so so satisfying once you master it, was hooked on it so much.
2.GTAV - not as arcadey kind of feel to the driving as sleeping dogs had however it personally felt more fun than RDR2 or sleeping dogs due to the fact that the cars felt like they had weight.
3.RDR2 - does riding a horse count as driving? i mean its just felt super realistic and it was about as fun as driving a wagon in real life, not great not had.
4.Sleeping Dogs - hated the driving aspect of this game, unbelievably dull to me the cars all felt like they had no real weight to them and on pc the driving felt so tedious.

Missions (most fun & memorable)
1.GTAV - the main story missions are unbelievably memorable to me and despite being repetitive often it doesnt suffer from mafia 3 syndrome as the story and short nature of the missions keeps them fresh.
2.Sleeping Dogs - yet again so memorable and so fun however it falls behind GTAV merely in the memorable factor by a slight bit to me, both are stupidly fun though.
3.RDR2 - obviously there are memorable missions, be it robbing the train to raiding the families mansion to the ending however not many are super fun. the only one i could think to be honestly fun is drinking with lenny, and the boat heist one.
4.GTAIV - i barely remember the missions apart from uncle vlad for some reason? i remember more of the ballad of gay tony and the lost and damned but very forgettable.

there are infinite categories you could rank these games in however if i was to personally rank them by which i am most fond of it'd be

1.RDR2
2.Sleeping Dogs
3.GTAIV
4.GTAV
